record.paper_title: AUTOMORPHISMS AND DYNAMICS: A LIST OF OPEN PROBLEMS
record.original_question: Let X be a complex projective variety of dimension 3. If X admits a minimal automorphism f, meaning that every orbit of f is dense and hence the only f-invariant closed subsets are X and the empty set, must X be an abelian variety?

evidence.quote: A continuous transformation g of a compact metric space M is minimal if each of its orbits are dense; equivalently, the only g-invariant closed subsets are M and the empty set.
Question 3.3. Let X be a complex projective variety of dimension 3. Suppose that there is a minimal automorphism f on X. Is X an abelian variety ?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective variety of dimension $3$, and let $f \colon X \to X$ be an automorphism. Call $f$ minimal if every orbit of $f$ is dense in $X$ for the Zariski (equivalently, the Euclidean) topology; equivalently, the only $f$-invariant closed subsets of $X$ are $X$ itself and the empty set. Suppose that $X$ admits such a minimal automorphism $f$. Must $X$ be an abelian variety (i.e., isomorphic, as a complex projective variety, to a complex abelian threefold, with $f$ then necessarily a translation)?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in a survey on automorphisms and dynamics. A web search did not find any published resolution: in dimension 2 it is known that a minimal automorphism forces the surface to be an abelian surface, but no analogous theorem in dimension 3 appears in the literature. Status remains open as of the search date.

status_evidence.title: Notes on automorphism groups of projective varieties (Brion)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of automorphism groups and dynamics on projective varieties, without resolution of the threefold minimal-automorphism question.
status_evidence.claim: No proof of the threefold case is recorded in this survey-style reference.

status_evidence.title: Fibered Calabi-Yau threefolds with relative automorphisms of positive entropy
status_evidence.snippet: Studies automorphisms of Calabi-Yau threefolds; does not address minimality forcing abelian structure.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on threefold automorphism dynamics does not settle the minimal-automorphism question.
